about:
Alabama Gulf Coast Wood Designs operates from Mobile, Alabama, serving the Gulf Coast region with custom carpentry and woodworking services. The business appears to be a sole proprietorship run by a single craftsman, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available information.

The shop produces handmade furniture — including tables, benches, chairs, beds, and shelves — along with custom architectural woodwork such as kitchen fittings, joinery, wood wall paneling, and custom windows and doors. Services also cover furniture repair and reassembly. The operation runs from a residential address on Wakefield Drive West, suggesting a small-scale, owner-operated workshop rather than a large production facility.

Customers include homeowners and businesses in the Mobile area seeking bespoke wood pieces, custom installations, and repair work. The website highlights residential projects like kitchen fittings and custom doors, as well as one-off furniture commissions. A single public review from March 2021 praises the quality of the woodwork and customer service.

The owner emphasizes a fusion of passion, experience, and custom design as the core differentiator, aiming to handle ambitious projects with a personal touch from start to finish. Free consultations and 24/7 availability are offered as service commitments.
